python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# Data for fiscal years 2010-2012
x = np.array([2010, 2011, 2012])
y = np.array([1293454, 1295591, 1089353])  # in millions

# Calculate OLS regression
x_mean = np.mean(x)
y_mean = np.mean(y)

# Slope (beta_1)
numerator = np.sum((x - x_mean) * (y - y_mean))
denominator = np.sum((x - x_mean) ** 2)
beta_1 = numerator / denominator

# Intercept (beta_0)
beta_0 = y_mean - beta_1 * x_mean

print(f"Slope (beta_1): {beta_1}")
print(f"Intercept (beta_0): {beta_0}")

# Predict for fiscal year 2013
x_2013 = 2013
y_pred = beta_0 + beta_1 * x_2013

print(f"\nPredicted total financing for fiscal year 2013: {y_pred:.2f} million USD")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(y_pred, 2)}")
EOF
